result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Corio has a 30-day convenience-termination right and receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Commerce One has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term. The existing mutual nonrenewal right applies only at term end. However, allowing termination “in part” is broader than necessary and undefined, and placing Section 11.1.1 after Section 11.2 is structurally awkward. These issues reduce minimality and drafting quality but do not defeat compliance.
